subject: Demo coordination: APAC availability + DST fallback plan
messages:
From: Hana Mori <hana.mori@kyoto-biomed.jp>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 23:07:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo - APAC participants OOO next week

Hi Stephanie / team,

Quick heads up from our side: several stakeholders in Tokyo and Mumbai will be OOO or on reduced hours around the first week of November due to overlapping regional observances (Golden Week planning day for a few labs in our group + Diwali-related leave for engineering in Mumbai). That means the original demo slot on Nov 4 will leave key folks out.

Would it be possible to move the session to the following week (preferably Tue/Wed Nov 9–10) or to offer a separate APAC-friendly window? We can do 09:00–11:00 JST on Nov 9 if that helps — that catches both Tokyo and most of India at a reasonable time.

One more ask: can you include a short compliance & data residency section? Our security lead will only join if that's covered.

Thanks,
Hana
Hana Mori
Head of Partnerships — Kyoto Biomed
hana.mori@kyoto-biomed.jp
+81 75 555 1212

P.S. recording is fine as a fallback but some internal stakeholders prefer a live slot for Q&A.
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hana Mori <hana.mori@kyoto-biomed.jp>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@midwesthealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo - APAC participants OOO next week

Hi Hana — thanks for the heads up and for suggesting Nov 9. We can absolutely accommodate.

Proposed options (live):
- Option A: Tue Nov 9, 09:00–10:30 JST (00:00–01:30 UTC) — APAC-first slot, recommended for Tokyo/Mumbai participation
- Option B: Wed Nov 10, 14:00–15:00 JST (05:00–06:00 UTC) — slightly later for EU overlap
- Option C: Keep Nov 4 but record + run a 30-minute APAC-only recap (if legal/security attendees are OOO)

I'll include a compliance/data-residency slide in the run of show and attach an updated agenda (demo-agenda-v2.pdf) and a mutual action plan template (mutual-action-plan.xlsx).

If APAC prefers Option A, we can schedule a 30-minute pre-demo sync for the compliance lead (Nov 8 morning JST). Vanessa, Jonas — can you confirm internal readiness for Nov 9 Option A?

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: demo-agenda-v2.pdf (Agenda, 2 pages); mutual-action-plan.xlsx (starter MAP)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Hana Mori <hana.mori@kyoto-biomed.jp>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:22:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo - APAC participants OOO next week

Thanks Steph — quick note from EU side: end-of-October DST changes mean a lot of calendar confusion the first couple of days in November; we should avoid scheduling solely by local times without a UTC anchor.

Also: across Germany and parts of the EU there are All Saints / bank holiday observances around Nov 1, so some of our EU contacts will be out until Nov 2. For the proposed Nov 9 slot, EU will be fine — we can join earlier if you need EU overlap.

Recommendation: pick Option A (Nov 9 APAC-first) as the canonical demo; publish the invite in UTC and include two explicit follow-ups: (1) recording + timestamped Q&A doc, (2) a 45-minute EU follow-up the same week (Nov 11) for extended discussion. That gives both regions a live option without forcing anyone to join at 03:00 local.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Product Manager, EMEA — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
From: Hana Mori <hana.mori@kyoto-biomed.jp>

Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 14:05:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo - APAC participants OOO next week

Steph — Option A (Nov 9 at 09:00 JST) works for us.

A couple of small asks:
- Can you add a short run-through of data residency + audit logs (5–7 minutes) near the start? Our compliance lead will dial in for that piece.
- We request that the recording be shared internally; we will mark sections that are sensitive and may request a redaction if needed.

Liam from Midwest Health (copied) asked whether the demo will be recorded and if it's ok to redistribute the recording to his procurement team. He said they will probably opt to watch the recording rather than join live due to US timezone.

We can do a 30-minute pre-demo on Nov 8 JST for a quick compliance sync; ideally 10:00–10:30 JST. Can your team make that?

Best,
Hana

- Pre-demo compliance sync: Mon Nov 8, 10:00–10:30 JST (recording will be off) — attendees: Hana, Kyoto compliance lead, Vanessa, Sergio

- Agenda & MAP: attached (demo-agenda-v2.pdf; mutual-action-plan.xlsx) — please add comments in the MAP before Nov 10 so we can incorporate requests during the EU follow-up.
